title: ANTHROSCORE: A Computational Linguistic Measure of Anthropomorphism

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating an 'ANTHROSCORE' by using a Masked Language Model (RoBERTa) to compute the log ratio of the probability of replacing a masked technical entity (e.g., 'model', 'algorithm') with human pronouns (he, she) versus non-human pronouns (it) based on the surrounding context.
